en.sayed-ali-raza: My relation with the Messenger of Allāh is that of one branch with another, or of the wrist with the forearm.

By Allāh, if the Arabs join together to fight me I will not run away from them and if I get the opportunity I will hasten to catch them by their necks. I shall surely strive to relieve the earth of this man of perverse mind and uncouth body, till the bits of earth are removed from the grain.
